source.title: As The Crow Flies
source.description:
I really should check in with Master Omnuron about this. However, you've been so helpful to the Druids of the Talon that I'll take a chance. I'm sure that he'll understand.

It's better to beg forgiveness than ask for permission anyway!

We'll leave now. You can't see the route we take to bypass the wards so I'll need to obscure your vision. This is irresponsible enough as it is and I definitely can't expose the secrets of the Druids of the Talon.
source.objective: Secure transport to the peak of Mount Hyjal.
source.completion:
Well, here we are.

I warn you, do not leave the immediate area of the summit. It will not go well for you. The druids that guard Nordrassil are not always what I'd call friendly. There's also a whole mountain full of other horrors up here that would love to make a meal out of a nice juicy <class> like you.

I suggest you finish up here as quickly as possible and speak with me again when you are ready to head back down to Everlook.

Good luck!
